new.s: What happened to the clean energy cess on coal, which financed the National Clean Energy Fund, after GST came in 2017?
o: It became part of the GST Compensation Cess

It was extended to petrol and diesel
new.x: After GST in 2017 the coal cess became the GST Compensation Cess, so the NCEF got no fresh inflows.

new.s: Which two scenarios does NITI Aayog's India Energy Security Scenarios (IESS) 2047 model?
new.x: IESS 2047 is NITI Aayog's open-access tool that models energy supply and demand to 2047 under Business-As-Usual and Ambitious scenarios.

new.s: Under the Panchamrit commitments made at COP26, what share of India's energy requirement is to come from renewable energy by 2030?
new.x: Panchamrit target 2 is that 50% of India's energy requirement will come from renewables by 2030 (not 60%).

new.s: By which year does India aim to achieve net zero emissions?
new.x: India's net-zero target year, announced as part of Panchamrit at COP26, is 2070. Andhra Pradesh aims for 2047.

new.s: With which foreign university has IIT Tirupati set up a solar Centre of Excellence in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The Andhra Pradesh solar Centre of Excellence is a partnership of IIT Tirupati and UNSW (University of New South Wales), announced on 31 July 2026.

new.s: What is the main objective of the National Clean Energy Fund?
o: To fund research and innovative projects in clean energy technologies
To pay the LPG subsidy to poor households
To compensate States for loss of revenue under GST
new.x: The NCEF was created to fund research and innovative clean energy projects, promoting renewable energy and cutting carbon emissions.

new.s: What was the source of money for the National Clean Energy Fund created in 2010-11?
o: A cess on coal, lignite and peat, both domestic and imported
A tax on petrol and diesel
new.x: The NCEF was funded by a clean energy cess on coal (also lignite and peat), levied on both domestic and imported coal.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a distributed energy resource?
new.x: Distributed energy resources are small units near the point of use, like rooftop PV, batteries, fuel cells and biomass generators. A large dam is centralised.

new.s: Which countries jointly launched the Global Biofuels Alliance at the G20 Summit in New Delhi in September 2023?
new.x: The Global Biofuels Alliance was launched by India, USA and Brazil at the G20 New Delhi summit (September 2023).

new.s: What is the main purpose of the Leadership Group for Industry Transition (LeadIT)?
o: Net-zero transition of heavy industry such as steel and cement
Financing rooftop solar in developing countries
new.x: LeadIT, launched by India and Sweden in 2019, works for the net-zero transition of heavy industry like steel and cement by 2050.

new.s: Where is Modhera, India's first 24x7 solar-powered village?
new.x: Modhera in Gujarat is India's first village powered by solar energy round the clock.

new.s: Which is the first fully solar-powered airport?
new.x: Cochin International Airport in Kerala is the first fully solar-powered airport.

new.s: Between which places does 'Aditya', India's first solar ferry (2017), operate?
new.x: Aditya, India's first solar-powered ferry (2017), runs between Vaikom and Thavanakkadavu in Kerala.

new.s: Which public sector company under MNRE implements the National Solar Mission?
